visual_review.identity: Light cool gray-white continuous snow cover with shallow blue-gray depressions and scattered small snow-capped gray stone groups. No exposed brown earth, vegetation, water or standing scene objects.
visual_review.detail_density: Around 25-30 visible stone accent groups, above the suggested 12-18. Snow remains continuous but subdivides into more shallow value patches than the requested 6-12 total broad regions.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Larger stone groups span roughly 10-22 world units at the proposed 256 period; many individual stone faces are about 6-15. Decorative scale is larger than initial 3-8-unit guidance.
visual_review.style_caveat: Much cleaner light snow faces than original with restrained low-contrast shading; some shallow facet subdivisions and softly textured fill remain. Source is a material candidate for catalog preview, not a scene pass.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 opaque native and snow identity passed. All current campaign consumers remain absent. No natural seamlessness claim.
